name: INCLUDE
intro: Include是一个综合性的、以知识和推理为中心的基准测试，旨在评估多语言大型语言模型在不同区域和文化背景下的表现。该基准测试包含197,243个问答对，来源于44种书面语言的本地考试资源，以解决现有评估资源不足和翻译偏差的问题。它通过收集特定国家的教育、专业和职业执照考试，确保了对区域知识和文化细微差别的准确反映，从而促进了多语言LLM在实际语言环境中的有效部署。
org: EPFL, Cohere For AI, Cohere For AI Community, ETH Zurich, Swiss AI Initiative
intro_en: Include is a comprehensive, knowledge- and reasoning-centered benchmark designed to evaluate multilingual large language models across different regions and cultural contexts. It contains 197,243 QA pairs sourced from native exam materials in 44 written languages, addressing the limitations of existing evaluation resources and translation biases. By collecting education, professional, and licensing exams specific to each country, it ensures accurate representation of regional knowledge and cultural nuances, promoting effective deployment of multilingual LLMs in real-world language settings.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.19799. INCLUDE is built from 197,243 MCQA pairs collected from 1,926 examinations across 44 languages, 15 scripts, and local sources in 52 countries. Native speakers and regional associations help collect academic exams, professional certifications, and regional licenses. Multiple extraction pipelines convert PDFs, JavaScript/HTML forms, and other formats into machine-readable questions, options, and answers. Native speakers verify extraction accuracy, manually correct errors, filter image/table-dependent samples, ensure context-dependent questions include reference text, and annotate language, topic, level, and country metadata. The benchmark also consolidates 78,637 samples from existing multilingual datasets, categorizes exams with a two-level academic taxonomy, labels regionality, and curates standardized INCLUDE-BASE and INCLUDE-LITE subsets.
